long_biography.plain_text:
Born in Vienna, Ersek moved to Colorado during middle school and studied entrepreneurship at the University of Colorado Boulder. He joined its Division I basketball team as a walk-on, completed a business degree and later played professionally in Austria.

Before moving into investment, he handled national retail distribution and sales strategy in the United States for Austrian drinks company waterdrop. He then joined his family's investment activity as managing director and co-founder of E&E, a venture platform linking Europe and the United States. Ersek sources young companies, leads investment diligence and helps portfolio businesses expand internationally. Beyond business, he co-founded Bright Connect, which promotes digital access and educational technology for students in underserved communities across sub-Saharan Africa.

Ersek sources young companies, leads investment diligence and helps portfolio businesses expand internationally. Beyond business, he co-founded Bright Connect, which promotes digital access and educational technology for students in underserved communities across sub-Saharan Africa.
